description: Find New York State DMV offices with street address, public phone number, weekday opening hours and coordinates. Covers all 175 county offices, district offices, mobile offices and traffic violations bureaus in the NYS DMV directory, so it answers "DMV office in Buffalo", "where is the DMV in ZIP 12207", "NYS DMV phone number in Albany", or "which New York DMV offices are mobile". For the sites where the road test itself is given use ny_dmv_road_test_sites.

city.description: City name, matched as a substring, e.g. "Buffalo", "Albany", "Brooklyn".

office_type.description: One of "COUNTY OFFICE", "DISTRICT OFFICE", "MOBILE OFFICE", "TRAFFIC VIOLATIONS BUREAU", matched as a substring.

name: ny_dmv_offices
title: Ny Dmv Offices
